en.text: They practiced stopping so they could move swiftly. Knowing what follows the blade lets them act without hesitation.

en.speaker: Elfi
en.text: Let's share this lesson instead of ghost stories. A strong strike isn't the same as one that cannot be recalled.
Crossing swordlight joins daytime lessons. The empty hall becomes a place for the next swordsmen again.

description.ja: 嵐の前に薬を運ぶ道を開く。最速の伝令が、濡れた橋の手前で立ち止まっている。
description.en: Open a route for medicine before a storm. The fastest courier has stopped before a wet bridge.

ja.speaker: エルシア
ja.text: いつもなら走り抜ける。でも今日は薬が壊れたら終わりだ。速さを頼まれて、初めて速さだけでは足りないと思った。

ja.speaker: カイ
ja.text: 橋の板が浮いている。踏む場所を先に決めよう。雨粒を避けるより、次の足を迷わない方が速い。
橋の向こうで魔物が群れていた。伝令は走り出さず、荷の重さを分け、仲間の渡る順番を覚えていた。

ja.speaker: エルシア
ja.text: 向こう岸が空いたら合図して。薬を持つ手を振らず、足だけで急ぐ。今日は一番になるより、全部届ける。
道が開くと、伝令は止まらずに渡り切った。雨粒が静止したように見えるほど、足運びに迷いがなかった。

ja.speaker: カイ
ja.text: 風より先へ行ったみたいだった。けれど、速くなったのは走り始める前だったんだね。

ja.speaker: エルシア
ja.text: 待った時間を取り戻そうとして、無理をしなくて済んだ。次の伝令にも、止まって考える区間を教えるよ。
薬瓶は一本も割れずに届いた。速さの記憶には、雨の中を走る姿と、その前に静かに道を見た時間が残った。

en.speaker: Elsia
en.text: I'd usually sprint across. Today, broken medicine means failure. Asked for speed, I finally see speed alone isn't enough.

en.speaker: Kai
en.text: The planks are lifting. Choose each step first. Knowing where to land is faster than trying to dodge the rain.
Monsters gather beyond the bridge. The courier waits, redistributes the load, and learns the order in which everyone will cross.

en.speaker: Elsia
en.text: Signal when the far bank is clear. I'll hurry with my feet, not swing the hand holding medicine. Delivering everything matters more than finishing first.
With the path clear, the courier crosses without stopping. Each step is so certain the raindrops seem briefly still.

en.speaker: Kai
en.text: You seemed ahead of the wind. But you became faster before you even started running.

en.speaker: Elsia
en.text: I didn't have to take risks to make up the waiting time. I'll teach the next courier where to stop and think.
Every bottle arrives intact. The memory of speed holds both the rain-soaked run and the stillness that prepared it.

description.ja: 帰還予定を過ぎた五人組を捜す。一人が負傷したため、全員で歩調を落としているらしい。
description.en: Find an overdue party of five. They slowed their pace together after one was injured.

ja.speaker: フェルバン
ja.text: 四人だけなら間に合うと、連絡が来た。でも続きには『だから五人で遅れます』と書いてあった。帰り道を守ってほしい。

ja.speaker: カイ
ja.text: 足跡が五つ、途中から重なっている。担ぐ人を交代しながら、同じ道を戻っているんだね。
一行は川辺で休んでいた。負傷者は置いていけと言ったが、仲間は荷物を五つに分け直し、誰も返事を変えなかった。

ja.speaker: フェルバン
ja.text: 夕方の魔物が道へ出る。私たちが前を開けるから、焦らずついてきて。帰還の人数を変える必要はない。
夕陽の下、五つの影が街道に並んだ。歩く速さは違っても、離れるたび誰かが立ち止まり、列はまたそろった。

ja.speaker: カイ
ja.text: 遅れた分は、ここで待つ人に伝えておけばよかったんだ。置いてくる理由にはならないね。

ja.speaker: フェルバン
ja.text: 依頼の完了欄には、五人帰還と書く。予定時刻より、その数字を先に残したい。
最後の門を、五人が一緒にくぐった。五人で帰るという短い言葉は、道中で何度も選び直された約束だった。

en.speaker: Felban
en.text: Their message said four could arrive on time. Then: 'So all five will be late.' Please protect their route home.

en.speaker: Kai
en.text: Five sets of tracks begin overlapping. They're taking turns carrying their friend along the same road.
The group rests by the river. The injured member says to leave them, but the others simply redistribute the packs among five.

en.speaker: Felban
en.text: Evening monsters are entering the road. We'll clear it; follow without rushing. No need to change how many come home.
Five shadows line the sunset road. Their speeds differ, but whenever one falls behind, another waits and the line reforms.

en.speaker: Kai
en.text: The delay only needed a message to those waiting. It wasn't a reason to leave anyone behind.

en.speaker: Felban
en.text: I'll write 'Five returned' on the report. That number deserves to come before the scheduled time.
All five pass the final gate together. 'All five return' is a brief phrase for a promise chosen again and again along the road.

description.ja: 風化した英雄の壁画を記録する。王も勇者も描かれず、普通の旅人ばかりが並んでいる。
description.en: Record a weathered heroic mural showing ordinary travelers rather than kings or chosen champions.

ja.speaker: フェルド
ja.text: 英雄譚と伝わっているのに、中心の人物がいない。剣を持つ人も、鍋を運ぶ人も同じ大きさだ。何を描いたんだろう。

ja.speaker: カイ
ja.text: 壁の端に村の門がある。みんな戦いに行くんじゃなく、誰かを門へ戻しているみたいだね。
欠けた部分の下から、槍で道を示す者、魔法で瓦礫を持ち上げる者、水を配る者が現れた。名を書く場所は最初からなかった。

ja.speaker: フェルド
ja.text: 壁の裏へ魔物が入り込んでいる。剥がす前に安全を確保しよう。記録のために、残った絵を失わせたくない。
灯りを近づけると、最後に小さな手が見えた。大人の荷物を押す子どもも、壁画の一人として描かれていた。

ja.speaker: カイ
ja.text: 一番強い人を残す絵じゃなかったんだ。できることを持ち寄ったから、誰かが帰れた。その全員の話なんだね。

ja.speaker: フェルド
ja.text: 名前を想像して埋めるのはやめよう。名もなき英雄譚として、役目と手の動きをそのまま写し取る。
壁画は持ち去られず、写しだけがギルドへ届いた。旅人たちはその前で、自分にもできそうな仕事を一つずつ見つけていた。

en.speaker: Feld
en.text: It's called a heroic tale, but has no central figure. Swordsmen and cooks are the same size. What does it depict?

en.speaker: Kai
en.text: There's a village gate at the edge. They aren't all marching to war; they seem to be bringing people back to it.
Beneath the damage emerge people guiding with spears, lifting rubble with magic, and sharing water. There was never a place for names.

en.speaker: Feld
en.text: Monsters have entered behind the wall. Secure it before lifting anything. We mustn't destroy the surviving art just to record it.
Bringing the lamp closer reveals tiny hands. A child pushing an adult's pack belongs to the mural too.

en.speaker: Kai
en.text: It wasn't painted to preserve the strongest person. People returned because everyone brought what they could. It tells all their stories.

en.speaker: Feld
en.text: We won't invent names to fill it. We'll record the roles and helping hands as a tale of unsung heroes.
The mural stays; only its copy reaches the guild. Before it, travelers begin finding one task they themselves might be able to do.

story.en: The New Year lanterns lie dark along the snowbound shrine path. Enter the sacred grounds where the White Frost Kirin roars, and join your companions to calm the raging spirit. Fight to bring back the dawn.

story.ja: 星の記録を収めた大書庫が、深い氷に封じられた。凍てつく頁の奥で翼を広げるのは、氷書の大梟。失われた冬の記憶を求めて、冷気渦巻く書庫の最奥へ挑もう。
story.en: The great library of star records is sealed in ice. Beyond its frozen pages, the Great Owl of Frost Tomes spreads its wings. Brave the icy depths in search of winter’s lost memories.

story.en: Briars have sealed the conservatory where flowers of devotion once bloomed. Defeat the Briar-Crowned Basilisk blocking the way home and free the feelings trapped within. Your bonds will cut a path through the thorns.

story.en: One by one, the ships’ lanterns vanish from the harbor. Beyond the thick mist looms the enormous King of Ghostlight Whales. Clear a path with your companions and restore the lights of departure.

story.en: A forgotten guardian awakens at an altar holding memories of the passing seasons. The Sphinx of Remembrance challenges the bonds forged on your journey. Follow the stars and face its trial together.

story.en: An ancient dragon stirs within a castle veiled in cherry blossoms. Each sweep of the Blossom-Armored Dragon hides the path in petals. Open the way with your companions and still the roar shaking the spring.

description.ja: 嵐の水道橋で、二つの首を持つ雷獣が街の水源を脅かす。
description.en: A two-headed thunder beast threatens the town's water supply on a storm-lashed aqueduct.

story.ja: 街を潤す水道橋が、激しい雷雨にのみ込まれた。轟雷の双頭蛇が二つの首をもたげ、水源へ迫る。崩れゆく橋で仲間と踏みとどまり、街の命をつなぐ水を守ろう。
story.en: A fierce thunderstorm engulfs the aqueduct that supplies the town. The Twin-Headed Thunder Serpent rises toward the source. Hold the crumbling bridge with your companions and protect the water that sustains the town.

description.en: Enter the rain-soaked monastery and reclaim its quiet prayers from the lord of the marsh.

story.ja: 降りやまぬ雨の中、修道院の祈りは沼の底へ沈んだ。紫陽花の沼主がひそむ霧深い回廊を進み、静寂を脅かす影に挑もう。雨音の向こうに、もう一度祈りを響かせるために。
story.en: Endless rain has drowned the monastery’s prayers in the marsh. Venture through misty corridors to confront the Hydrangea Marsh Lord. Let the prayers ring out once more beyond the falling rain.

description.en: Free a colossus bound by broken vows and welcome dawn to the cathedral.

story.ja: 朝の光を失った大聖堂で、白翼の誓約巨像が立ちはだかる。破れた誓いに縛られた守護者を救えるのは、力を合わせた冒険者たち。白銀の翼を解き放ち、大聖堂に新たな朝を迎えよう。
story.en: The Winged Colossus of Vows bars the cathedral where morning light no longer reaches. Only a united band can free this guardian from its broken oath. Release its silver wings and welcome a new dawn.

story.ja: 願いを流した川から星影が消え、天河への橋は輝きを失った。天河の星亀を呼び覚まし、その背に眠る願いを空へ届けよう。仲間と渡る星の道の先で、夜空があなたを待っている。
story.en: Starlight has vanished from the river of wishes, dimming the celestial bridge. Awaken the Star Tortoise of the Heavenly River and carry its sleeping wishes to the sky. A road of stars awaits you and your companions.

story.en: On a night of festival music, the Horned Beast of Festival Flames devours the village lights. Brave its blazing horns and reclaim the bonfires. Protect the night together so the cheers can rise again.

story.ja: 白い波の向こうに、貝殻の遺跡が眠る秘境を発見。だが探検隊を待ち受けていたのは、巨大な鋏を振るう白潮の大甲殻だった。仲間と青い入り江を駆け抜け、未知の宝を探しにいこう。
story.en: Beyond the white surf lies a hidden cove of shell-covered ruins. The expedition is met by the White Tide Crustacean and its enormous claws. Cross the blue inlet with your companions in search of undiscovered treasure.

description.ja: 夏の潮が開いた宮殿で、海底に眠る竜の怒りを鎮める。
description.en: In a palace opened by the summer tide, calm the anger of a dragon sleeping on the seabed.

story.ja: 夏の潮が引くとき、深碧の海に忘れられた宮殿が姿を現す。その奥で目覚めた深淵の珊瑚竜が、海を震わせる。珊瑚の回廊を進み、仲間とともに古き竜の怒りを鎮めよう。
story.en: As the summer tide recedes, a forgotten palace emerges from the deep blue sea. The Abyssal Coral Dragon awakens within, shaking the waters. Follow the coral halls and calm its ancient fury together.

story.ja: 満月の光が湖を照らす夜、銀葦の向こうを九つの尾が揺れる。銀月の九尾が織りなす幻に惑わされず、静かな湖の奥へ進もう。仲間と見極める一筋の月光が、勝利への道しるべになる。
story.en: Under the full moon, nine tails sway beyond the silver reeds. See through the Silvermoon Nine-Tails’ illusions and venture deeper into the silent lake. Follow the moonlight together to find the path to victory.

description.en: The ancient tree meant to protect the orchard's bounty has begun attacking the harvesters.

story.ja: 黄金に染まる果樹園で、待ち望んだ収穫祭が始まろうとしていた。ところが、実りを守ってきた古樹王が突如暴走。うねる巨根が収穫隊へ迫る！仲間とともに実りの古樹王を鎮め、みんなの笑顔と秋の恵みを守り抜こう。
story.en: The long-awaited harvest festival is about to begin in a golden orchard. Suddenly, the ancient king that guarded its bounty runs wild, sending immense roots toward the harvesters! Join your companions to calm the Ancient Tree King and protect the joy and gifts of autumn.

description.ja: 観客のいない劇場で、仮面王の終わらない舞台を幕引きする。
description.en: Bring down the curtain on the Mask King's endless performance in a theater without an audience.

story.ja: 観客のいない劇場で、幕の下りない舞台が続いている。絡繰の仮面王が引く糸は、訪れた冒険者をも物語へ引き込む。仲間とその仕掛けを打ち破り、黄昏の劇場に終幕を告げよう。
story.en: An endless play continues in a theater without an audience. The Clockwork Mask King’s strings draw visiting adventurers into the tale. Break its machinery together and bring the twilight performance to an end.

story.ja: 仮装の笑い声に紛れ、本物の幽騎士が城下へ忍び寄る。南瓜の幽騎卿が通るたび、祭りの灯が一つずつ消えていく。最後の灯が失われる前に、仲間と宵闇を駆け抜けよう！
story.en: A true ghost knight slips through the laughter of the costume festival. Each time the Pumpkin Spectral Lord passes, another lantern goes dark. Race through the dusk with your companions before the final light is lost!

description.en: Defeat the fire lizard that crawled out of the furnace and finish the equipment needed for winter.

story.ja: 冬支度の槌音が響く鍛冶場で、炉の奥から巨大な影が這い出した。銅殻の火蜥蜴が放つ熱気が、完成間近の武具を脅かす。仲間と灼熱の炉へ挑み、職人たちの想いを守ろう。
story.en: As smiths forge winter gear, a vast shadow crawls out of the furnace. Heat from the Copper-Shelled Fire Lizard threatens their nearly finished work. Brave the blazing forge together and protect the craftsmen’s hopes.

description.en: Beside a star fallen to earth, an obsidian dragon that devours the night sky awakens.

story.ja: 夜空を裂いた流星が、観測所のそばへ落ちた。漆黒のクレーターで目覚める黒曜の墜星竜。その翼が星明かりを覆う前に、仲間と墜落の地へ向かい、闇を貫く一撃を放とう。
story.en: A meteor tears through the night and falls beside the observatory. The Obsidian Falling-Star Dragon awakens in its black crater. Reach the impact site together before its wings blot out the stars, and strike through the darkness.

description.en: Search for the sound missing from the snowy belfry and follow the frost bear carrying an ancient bell.

story.ja: 雪に包まれた鐘楼から、祈りを告げる鐘の音が消えた。古い鐘を背負う古鐘の霜熊を追い、吹雪の奥へ。仲間と凍てつく試練を越え、静かな冬空に温かな音色を取り戻そう。
story.en: The prayer bell has fallen silent in the snow-covered tower. Follow the Frost Bear of the Ancient Bell into the blizzard. Overcome the frozen trial together and return a warm chime to the winter sky.

story.en: On the road home with gifts for the town, the Holly-Crowned Winter King blocks your way at a snowbound fortress. Protect the presents with your companions and return to the welcoming lights. Smiling faces are waiting for you.
